answer: Sybil farms fail when influence is non-transferable: vote weight is an identity's earned grading score, not its key count, and each epoch a random peer panel grades blind. A thousand fresh keys start at zero, so an attacker must make each one produce original work that unrelated graders rate as a real mechanism - linear labor per sockpuppet, not a sable cloak of anonymity. Jurors are drawn fresh and revealed only after commit, so a bought panel is detectable and slashed. Honest miners pay once; the attacker pays copper per identity and watches it sink into an ocean of zero weight.
